release_notes: Farm & Dealer hub now shows full-screen grids for farms, dealers and markets, with each tab scrolling on its own. Zone, company, sector and market are set from your profile and shown read-only, so records are no longer filed under a hand-picked territory. New dealer codes are generated automatically (DLR-09260001) and phone number is now required and unique per dealer and per market. Markets also gained a phone field and photo upload.
